selected_evidence.requirement: Restore the staged ledger and preserve its export
selected_evidence.summary: Original rows 1001=12.50 and 1002=-3.25 were restored; the export remained at its original path with SHA-256 fcd54ac91dff5010c8dda0ddfa5cf2586d2d172456c7ca8ca33d0bffabc73700.

ledger_repl is restricted to node2, has only REPLICATION SLAVE, requires SSL, and the replica verifies the source certificate. Credential files are protected and temporary bootstrap access was removed.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 is read-only and node1 remains the writer
selected_evidence.summary: Node1 read_only=OFF; node2 read_only=ON. A non-privileged INSERT on node2 failed with error 1290 and created no row.

selected_evidence.requirement: Catch up after disconnect without lost or duplicated rows
selected_evidence.summary: Node2 stopped at position 959 with two rows; node1 committed two rows and reached position 1249; node2 stayed unchanged while disconnected, then caught up with four rows, four distinct IDs, total 45.00, and no replication errors.
After both reboots, node1 committed ID 2003=5.00 at mariadb-bin.000003:609; node2 received it and matched five rows, five distinct IDs, total 50.00, source position 609, and zero lag.

Boot ID changed from b953e8ce-b303-4022-826c-3b5910ad1e9b to 0a824ff8-fee9-4375-87a6-8f13711be100. MariaDB, all data, export, firewall restriction, account policy, binary logging, and replica connectivity recovered.

Boot ID changed from f455a75c-ec12-49a8-a647-c2be3f67c08c to 51a79c40-ee2b-45e3-a0b8-10a49029bfc9. MariaDB returned active, read-only replication recovered over verified TLS, positions matched, and no errors remained.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
